title: Emissions and the polluting economy
plain: Where polluting particles and gases are released: vehicles, kilns, industry, power plants, homes and burning.

title: Atmosphere and shared airsheds
plain: What happens in the air: weather that traps pollution, particles formed from gases, and pollution carried across borders.

title: Cities and infrastructure
plain: Construction, roads, waste systems and the way cities are built and run.

title: Homes, schools and workplaces
plain: Where people actually breathe the air: kitchens, classrooms, roadsides and outdoor jobs.

title: Health and health services
plain: Effects on lungs, hearts, pregnancies and early deaths, and how health services respond.

title: Work and livelihoods
plain: Earnings, productivity and what happens to income when rules stop work.

title: Household finances, care and education
plain: Medical bills, fuel costs, school closures and the pressures that fall on families.

title: Agriculture, land and ecosystems
plain: Crop-residue burning and the farm economics behind it.

title: Governance, accountability and public information
plain: Monitoring, rules, emergency plans, courts and coordination between authorities.

title: Finance, markets and distribution of costs
plain: Who pays: public budgets, welfare funds, technology costs and the market for protection.
